errors.text: The proposed substitution removes W even though W is not present in the HfMoTaTiZr baseline.
The baseline is incorrectly described as having a continuous ordered B2 phase; the target baseline is an as-cast single-phase BCC alloy.
The proposed boundary condition excludes Laves-phase formation, whereas the target mechanism requires approximately 4 vol% of a reticulated Cr-rich Laves phase.
The intervention replaces the specific 4.2 at.% Cr addition by a speculative V/Cr substitution plus annealing route.
The experiment uses tensile elongation as its principal ductility metric rather than matching the room-temperature compression fracture-strain comparison.
